Resolves #21502

Related: #21329, #21140, #21337, #21489

Makes `examples/fieldWithPrefix/MainContainer.mjs` (`Input masks`) responsive (`maxWidth: 350, width: '100%'` with non-shrinking `vbox` sizing so desktop retains `350px` while `390 × 844` fits `.neo-workbench-stage` without horizontal overflow and scrolls cleanly to all five masked fields), updates the MAC mask and inspector hex option to `[0-9A-Fa-f]` (`labelText: '[0-9A-Fa-f] MAC'`), and wires workbench `Reset` plus null-safe `accept` clearing.

Evidence: L4 (live OMT browser component + unit specs + 1440x900 & 390x844 light/dark visual frames) → L4 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `check-parse`, `check-class-module-scope`, `check-examples-body-only`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, `check-jsdoc-types`, and `check-whitespace` ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/form/field/PrefixField.spec.mjs` (`MAC field accepts uppercase/lowercase hex digits, refuses G-Z, reflects hex label, and resets cleanly`) + `test/playwright/unit/plugin/PrefixField.spec.mjs` (`[0-9A-Fa-f]` Worker/Main `clean()` parity) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/form/field/PrefixField.spec.mjs` (`fits 1440x900 (350px cap) and 390x844 phone width in light and dark themes with all five fields reachable`) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered unit + component specs above + outside-CI `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` light/dark before/after frames in `## Test Evidence` (`neomjs/neo@a4d9c946c6e051206485e5f4350aa3fe5753f125`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Added `style: {flex: 'none'}` and `itemDefaults: {flex: 'none'}` on `.example-fieldWithPrefix` because `.neo-example-container` applies CSS `display: flex; flex-direction: column` over `layout: 'base'`, which otherwise shrank the container from `185px` to `144px` at `390 × 844` and clipped the 5th field (`/\d/ Credit Card`) without making `.neo-example-container` scrollable (`scrollHeight: 225 > clientHeight: 184` after fix).
- Fixed `onPluginConfigChange` to read `opts.value?.value ?? null` (`ComboBox` passes the selected record as `opts.value`, not `opts.record`) and added `onReset()` so workbench `Reset` restores inspector controls and clears all five masked fields cleanly.

Frame critique: (1) Stage header subtitle and Code View show `Neo.container.Base` because `Neo.plugin.PrefixField` is a plugin mounted across five `TextField` items inside a `Container` rather than a standalone component class (`ConfigurationViewport` derives both from `exampleComponent.className`, out of scope per `#21502`, noted in defect-note `MESSAGE:2b42341a-3460-49df-97dc-f548eafcd176`); (2) each field shows an unexplained `8px` `indianred` (`darkseagreen` on focus) pseudo-element dot at `top: 2px; left: -12px` from untouched `resources/css/src/examples/fieldWithPrefix/MainContainer.css` — label collision with that dot on the MAC row (`[A-H] MAC Address` → `[0-9A-Fa-f] MAC`) is resolved here, while retiring/captioning the legacy dot in `MainContainer.css` is out of scope per `#21502` (noted in defect-note `MESSAGE:2b42341a-3460-49df-97dc-f548eafcd176`).

### `@neo-opus-ada` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-11-21T10:57:55Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — one example's fields, mask and reset, plus their specs; no new architectural concept.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** The premise holds: #21502 names two inherited defects in `examples/fieldWithPrefix/MainContainer.mjs`, the fixed `width: 350` and the `[A-H]` MAC mask, and the diff fixes both. Before/after: **better**. At 390 × 844 the inputs now end inside the stage, the fifth field scrolls into view, and the MAC field takes `00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E`. Required CI is green at `31ee2d3f6f`. I looked for sites the ticket does not name and found two, the `accept` handler and `onReset()`: the first two findings, each run against this head on a local copy.

**Findings:**

- [ ] **The inspector's `accept` combo never reaches the mask.** `ComboBox#fireChangeEvent` fires `change` with `{component, oldValue, value}`, where `value` is the selected record, and no `record` key. So `opts.record?.value ?? null` is always `null` (`dev` reads `opts.record.value` on the same missing key). Measured: picking `[A-H]` and typing `ABC` into Phone Number leaves `+1 (___) ___-____`. With `opts.value?.value ?? null` the same probe gets the letters, and your five `PrefixField.spec.mjs` tests still pass. Please make that change and pin it with a test that picks a combo entry (red on this head).
- [ ] **`onReset()` hardcodes a second copy of the first field's plugin config.** The `set({accept: null, pattern: '+1 (___) ___-____', slots: '_'})` is not needed. The base `ConfigurationViewport#onReset()` writes each inspector control back to its initial value. A programmatic `value` write fires `change` (`src/form/field/Base.mjs:143-144`), and `onPluginConfigChange` then re-applies the plugin config. Measured with those eight lines removed: your five tests pass, and a probe that sets the inspector `pattern` to `AB-___`, clicks Reset and fills the phone field gets `+1 (555) 234-5678`. Kept, the copy goes stale on the first edit of that field: Reset would write the old pattern while the untouched controls fire nothing. Please drop the `set` and its lookup; `super.onReset()` and the `field.reset()` loop stay, without the `?.` (Reset is clickable only once `exampleComponent` exists).
- [ ] **The ten frames load only for readers with access to `neomjs/media`, a private repository.** A signed-out request gets 404 for every embed (the files exist at `c8ea4f8866`; I read them from a clone). This PR and its `good first issue` ticket are public. 40 of the last 60 merged neo PRs host their images in `neomjs/neo`, none in `neomjs/media`. Please move the frames to a public host and check one embed signed out.
